lines.text: Mind your step. Everything down here is trapped, including me.
lines.spoken: Mind your step. Everything down here is trapped... including me.

lines.text: That relic belongs in my satchel. You belong in the sand.
X marks the spot. The spot was your jaw.
Seven curses and one bad map, and you were the easy part.
Mind the loose flagstone. Ah. Too late.
Your tomb was easier to crack than your guard, pharaoh.
